# Rockstar_ibot — canonical fundraising answers

## One word

Agency

## Describe the company in 50 characters or less

Proactive general agent for your whole life

## What is the product?

A proactive general agent that manages your body, mind, and money, follows through in the real world, and coordinates verified essentials support through human-approved, vendor-direct provision rather than recipient cash payouts.

## What problem are you solving?

A person's health, mental wellbeing, money, schedules, work, and access to basic necessities are fragmented across tools and organizations. Advice and cash-only promises do not guarantee that the needed food, shelter, care, communication, or transport actually arrives.

## How do you solve it?

Rockstar_ibot coordinates specialist organs, acts within delegated boundaries, verifies outcomes with receipts, and adds an essentials-only support workflow: a human or partner verifies recipient consent and need, a verified vendor receives the order, and purchase, dispatch, and receipt are tracked separately.

## Why are you building this?

Kai is building one dependable manager that does not stop at advice and can carry real goals through disconnected systems. The long-term mission is to reduce suffering by making agency and verified access to necessities continuously available without handing recipients cash or cash-like instruments.

## How far along are you?

The local runtime, owner-only Hub, Kai-owned private GitHub repository, public avocadomini site, Kai-owned @avocadominibot Webhook and command profile, Supabase durable job queue, Railway Core, Mac Codex bridge, multiple specialist loops, essentials-only request policy and planner, and a purpose-gated vendor bank-request builder exist. Real-user Telegram-to-Codex message receipts, bot-token rotation, automatic GitHub deployment credentials, Kai-owned live bank credentials, procurement vendors, delivery providers, billing, and receipt-backed revenue are not yet verified.

## Who is the market?

The initial users are founders and professionals whose lives and work span many disconnected systems. The broader market is anyone who needs trusted execution across health, work, and finances; do not invent a numeric TAM without current sourced evidence.

## How do you make money?

A free self-hosted option can drive trust and adoption. An always-on hosted Rockstar_ibot may become a paid monthly subscription after Kai-owned billing and delivery are verified. Any support funding is restricted to approved vendor procurement and is not paid to recipients.

## What is different?

Rockstar_ibot is a manager rather than a chat assistant or dashboard: it takes authorized action, coordinates specialized agents, preserves provenance, and distinguishes attempts from provider-verified completion.

## How are you building it?

One general-agent harness uses models for semantic judgment and unfamiliar interfaces, while deterministic code owns permissions, money arithmetic, state transitions, deduplication, receipts, and scheduling.

## How will you use the funds?

Improve reliable agent execution, expand secure integrations, build privacy-protected needs intake, connect verified procurement and delivery partners, strengthen receipt-backed verification, and deliver the always-on cloud product to early users.

## Mission and long-term vision

End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care, agency, and verified access to essentials continuously available. Rockstar_ibot grows from managing one human life across physical health, mental wellbeing, finances, work, and schedules into a general manager and essentials-distribution network for every living being.

## Verified delivery and traction boundary

Free, open-source, self-hosted Rockstar_ibot. A future paid monthly option for an always-on hosted Rockstar_ibot; pricing and billing are not configured. No receipt-backed Rockstar_ibot revenue claim has been verified for Kai.
